1.name: Western Balkan scrub lanes
1.note: Narrow worn asphalt lanes with scrubby green verges, red-tiled houses and wire fences, wooded hills; few road lines.

2.name: German guardrail highways
2.note: White-lined two-lane and divided roads with guardrails and wooded verges; range adds field lanes and tree rows.

3.name: Rural Thailand roads
3.note: Two-lane asphalt with yellow center lines, dense dry tropical trees, concrete poles with wires, shophouses, red laterite verges.

4.name: Russian villages and forest roads
4.note: Worn asphalt and dirt village streets, metal sheet fences, wooden and brick houses with tin roofs, birch and pine forest-lined highways.

5.name: Finnish-Swedish pine forest roads
5.note: Pale gravel and asphalt roads through pine, spruce and birch forest, sandy verges, red and dark wooden houses.

6.name: Philippine concrete village lanes
6.note: Pale concrete roads, tin-roof houses and shacks, coconut and banana palms, dense green verges, power lines.

7.name: Malaysian palm towns and lanes
7.note: Lined roads past red-roofed houses and shophouses, oil and coconut palms, dense green verges, power lines.

8.name: Mainland Japan towns and paddies
8.note: Dense two-story houses, poles with many wires, white edge lines, rice paddies, forested cedar hills.

9.name: NZ suburbs and lowland pasture
9.note: White-dashed roads with grass verges, low suburban houses and fences, hedges, paddocks, wooden poles, often gray sky.

10.name: Southern Australian gum suburbs
10.note: Brick bungalows with tile roofs, gum trees, dry grass verges, wide marked streets and rural two-lanes, often gray sky.

11.name: Baltic open-field gravel roads
11.note: Pale gravel roads and white-lined two-lanes through flat green fields, birch and pine tree lines, cloudy skies.

12.name: Alpine-foreland meadow roads
12.note: White-lined narrow roads through lush meadows and maize, dark forest edges, chalet-style houses, rolling hills.

13.name: Colombian valley roads and towns
13.note: Lush green hills and trees, dirt tracks, double yellow center lines, colorful two-story town houses, yellow taxis and motorbikes.

14.name: Ukrainian leafy village roads
14.note: Worn gray asphalt and dirt lanes under leafy trees, brick walls and green metal fences, concrete poles, hazy or overcast sky.

15.name: Narrow Indonesian village lanes
15.note: Mostly unlined narrow lanes, tile-roof houses and shophouses close to the road, dense banana and palm greenery.

16.name: English hedged suburbs and lanes
16.note: Brick detached houses with gardens and hedges, red-brick walls, leafy narrow lanes, cloudy or sunny skies.

17.name: Kenyan red-dirt tracks
17.note: Orange-red dirt tracks with green bush and scattered trees, blurred camera hood at bottom, cumulus sky; some paved trunk roads.

18.name: Israeli and Jordanian suburbs
18.note: Beige stone apartment blocks and walled villas, red-white curbs, wide asphalt roads, dry plains and pines, hazy pale sky.

19.name: Smeared-hood Paraguay red dirt
19.note: Smeared car hood over red-orange dirt streets, low brick houses, concrete poles with wires, lush trees, cumulus sky; some yellow-line highways.

20.name: Argentine pampas towns
20.note: Low brick houses on leafy town streets, dirt side streets, wires on wooden poles, and flat grassy pampa two-lanes.

21.name: Turkish apartment towns
21.note: Balconied concrete apartment blocks, paver and cobbled streets, parked cars, dry flat plains with poplars.

22.name: Spanish apartment-row towns
22.note: Pale rendered apartment rows with balconies, parked cars, zebra crossings, plus dry field roads with guardrails.

23.name: Flat Midwest towns and farm roads
23.note: Pale concrete streets with lawns and mature trees, small houses, flat green crop fields along narrow farm roads.

24.name: Dense Mexican town streets
24.note: Brightly painted flat-roof concrete houses wall to wall, tangled overhead wires, pale concrete or dusty streets.

25.name: French hedged town edges
25.note: Gray-sky roads past rendered houses with walls, gates and hedges, white edge lines; range adds narrow field lanes.

26.name: Central Brazil paved town grids
26.note: Wide paved streets with walled single-story tile-roof houses, concrete poles with many wires, bright sky; range adds red-dirt pasture tracks.

27.name: Dry Indian plains lanes
27.note: Narrow worn asphalt or dirt lanes, dry scrub and thorn trees on flat plains, hazy lilac sky, camera car hood visible.

28.name: Ecuadorian towns and Andes roads
28.note: Concrete-block buildings on gray streets, overcast sky, double yellow center lines winding through steep green slopes.

29.name: Polish fenced village roads
29.note: Dashed-line roads past fenced detached houses with conifer hedges, paved sidewalks, poles; range adds open fields.

30.name: Southeast US wooded roads
30.note: Double-yellow two-lanes through pine and leafy woods, mown grass verges, brick ranch houses, leaf litter.

31.name: Pannonian wide-verge villages
31.note: Straight roads with wide grass verges, wooden poles, low gable houses with fences, flat plains under blue sky.

32.name: South African town streets
32.note: Wide sunny streets with red-sand verges, low houses behind walls and fences, leafy trees, street lights.

33.name: South Korean towns and valleys
33.note: Yellow center lines, tiled and brick multi-story shop blocks, dense signage, rail-edged roads, dry brown hills and farm fields.

34.name: Hazy Nigerian laterite roads
34.note: Orange laterite shoulders and dirt roads, hazy pale gray sky, dry savanna or green bush, tin-roof houses and stalls.

35.name: Canadian prairie roads
35.note: Flat open fields to a wide horizon, yellow-lined two-lanes and gravel shoulders, plus new curbed subdivisions under blue sky.

36.name: Smeared Panama and Costa Rica
36.note: Heavily smeared road surface, single-story houses with metal roofs and barred porches, lush green verges, white edge lines.

37.name: Norwegian hillside villages
37.note: Residential roads on green slopes, white and red wooden houses, stone retaining walls, hedges, gray-white skies.

38.name: Senegal sandy streets and highways
38.note: Pale yellow sand streets and shoulders, block-walled compounds, sparse acacias, hazy sky; range adds black-top highways and savanna.

39.name: Guatemalan pine-hill two-lanes
39.note: Yellow-lined two-lane roads through lush green scrub and scattered pines, cloudy hills, yellow warning signs, some walled houses.

40.name: Romanian village straights
40.note: Straight village roads with gravel shoulders, fenced plots, many poles and wires, red or metal-roofed houses, flat plains.

41.name: Ghanaian roadside towns
41.note: Paved two-lanes with orange dirt shoulders, cloudy skies, green bush, tin-roof shops and kiosks along the road.

42.name: Taiwanese hill roads and towns
42.note: Double-yellow center lines, lush subtropical hill roads with retaining walls, tiled multi-story townhouses, scooters, striped poles.

43.name: Forested Canadian two-lanes
43.note: Yellow-center two-lanes through spruce and deciduous woods, wide grass verges, wooden poles, sunny skies.

44.name: Greek olive-grove outskirts
44.note: Balconied white apartment houses, olive trees on dry slopes, pale worn roads, bright sun and dry yellow grass.

45.name: Northern Italian suburbs
45.note: Rendered ochre and pink apartment houses, fenced villas, white-lined roads, vine rows and leafy trees.

46.name: Qatar and UAE city roads
46.note: Multi-lane roads with tall lamp posts, beige walled villas, towers, curbed medians, pale sand lots; white car hood shows in some.

47.name: Lesotho highveld grass hills
47.note: Dirt tracks and yellow-edged roads over grassy plateaus and flat-topped hills, red soil cuts, small block houses.

48.name: Sri Lankan coconut-palm lanes
48.note: Narrow paved or red-earth lanes under coconut palms and dense green, painted walls and low tiled houses, white-lined two-lanes.

49.name: Peruvian brick-house towns
49.note: Unfinished brick and painted concrete houses, sandy streets, tangled wires, plus barren brown mountain dirt tracks.

50.name: Tunisian town boulevards
50.note: Wide hazy asphalt roads, white flat-roof concrete buildings, sandy shoulders and scrub verges, pickups and parked cars, pale sky.

51.name: Kyrgyz foothill villages
51.note: Visible camera car hood, dusty streets with metal fences and gates, poplars, tin-roof houses, mountains in the background.

52.name: Bangladeshi tree-shaded lanes
52.note: Narrow paved lanes under dense leafy trees and banana plants, tin-roof shacks and stalls, rickshaws, dusty edges.

53.name: Northeast Brazil walled towns
53.note: Rows of painted terraced houses with garage doors, dirt, cobble or paved streets, concrete poles, cumulus sky; range adds dry caatinga tracks.

54.name: Czech-Slovak panel-block towns
54.note: Town streets with panel apartment blocks, parked cars, rendered houses with red roofs and fences, poles with wires.

55.name: Irish hedge-lined rural roads
55.note: Gray skies, hedge-lined narrow roads through green pasture, white bungalows, wooden poles, rendered estate houses.

56.name: Cambodian dirt village roads
56.note: Orange-pink dirt roads, wooden stilt houses with blue tin roofs, palms, dry flat paddies, metal gates; pinkish color cast in many.

57.name: Central European forest lanes
57.note: Narrow unlined asphalt lanes inside dense spruce and beech forest, shaded green undergrowth, little sky.

58.name: Botswana thornveld roads
58.note: Hazy blue sky, yellow-edged roads and sand tracks through acacia thorn scrub, pale sandy verges, low town houses.

59.name: Nepal Terai and foothill lanes
59.note: Narrow lanes past rice paddies and green foothills, mud-brick houses, washed-out pale sky, often smeared or blurry road.

60.name: Dutch polder brick streets
60.note: Red brick terrace and villa streets, tree-lined lanes across flat green polders, ditches, red-paved bike lanes.

61.name: Hilly northern Vietnam lanes
61.note: Narrow concrete and asphalt lanes past lush green hillsides, narrow multi-story houses, banana plants, mostly overcast sky.

62.name: Mongolian plank-fence steppe
62.note: Tarp-bundled roof rack in view, open tan or green steppe, dirt tracks, plank-fenced towns with colored roofs, broken-cloud sky.

63.name: Green northern Iberian lanes
63.note: Narrow winding lanes with stone walls, granite houses, lush green fields and woods, wooden poles, terracotta roofs.

64.name: Flat Canadian suburbs and farmland
64.note: Brick subdivisions with curbs and lawns, flat farm-field roads with yellow center lines, deciduous trees.

65.name: Namibian sand-road towns
65.note: Pale yellow sand roads and flats, sparse thorn trees, low block houses and walls, white car hood often visible.

66.name: Bolivian altiplano towns
66.note: Red brick buildings on wide dusty streets, flat dry altiplano highways, deep blue skies, distant bare mountains.

67.name: Swedish hedged villa suburbs
67.note: Wide pale suburban roads with hedges, red and white wooden villas, low commercial buildings, curbs and lawns.

68.name: Lined Indonesian town roads
68.note: Center-lined two-lanes with sandy shoulders, low wooden and tin-roof houses, roadside kiosks, palms and open cumulus sky.

69.name: Icelandic open-plain roads
69.note: Treeless green or brown heath, narrow two-lanes and gravel roads with yellow-topped posts, distant mountains, gray overcast sky.

70.name: Flat Kazakh steppe villages
70.note: Visible camera car hood, flat open steppe, fenced brick houses with colored tin roofs, concrete poles, cumulus sky.

71.name: Dry central Chilean towns
71.note: Sunny streets with single-story houses behind metal fences, dense overhead wires, dry grass and scrub on open two-lanes.

72.name: Bulgarian curbed village streets
72.note: Wide pale patched roads with curbs, red-tiled houses behind walls, poles, mountains in the distance; range adds field roads.

73.name: Danish hedged bungalow streets
73.note: Flat roads lined by trimmed hedges, low brick bungalows, gray cloudy sky, curbs and open fields beyond.

74.name: Omani walls and rocky hills
74.note: Pale roads past beige walled compounds and bare rocky brown mountains, gravel desert verges, hazy blue sky.

75.name: Hilly Brazilian towns and tracks
75.note: Multi-story concrete and bare-brick buildings on slopes, red dirt tracks through green hills with wire pasture fences, yellow-line roads.

76.name: Green eastern Australian suburbs
76.note: Green lawns and lush gum and leafy trees, modern estate houses, white-lined roads through grassy open woodland.

77.name: Red-earth Brazil farm tracks
77.note: Bright red-orange dirt roads between crop fields, pine and eucalyptus stands, green rolling hills, some purplish color cast.

78.name: Eswatini dry hill roads
78.note: Dry tan grass hills, red-dirt and paved roads with yellow edge lines, scattered trees and low houses, hazy blue sky over distant hills.

79.name: Wooded US country roads
79.note: Yellow center lines, mowed lawns and leafy deciduous woods, wooden poles, mailboxes, clapboard houses set back from the road.

80.name: Georgian fenced village roads
80.note: Metal, stone and concrete fences, gated walls, fruit trees, Soviet blocks, cracked asphalt with tall poles.

81.name: Uruguayan pasture roads
81.note: Cracked narrow paved roads with yellow center lines or pale gravel, flat green pasture, eucalyptus clumps, often gray sky.

82.name: Bare-tree Russian steppe villages
82.note: Brown dry grass and bare trees, muddy dirt village streets, brick houses behind metal fences, flat treeless steppe highways.

83.name: Open dry Mexican roads
83.note: Dry scrub desert two-lanes and wide commercial avenues with billboards, scattered trees, strong blue sky with cumulus.

84.name: Vietnamese shop-lined highways
84.note: Yellow-line asphalt roads lined with shops and gated houses, motorbikes, concrete poles with tangled wires, palms, flat land.

85.name: Dry Portuguese scrub roads
85.note: White-lined roads through dry scrub and oak hills, white apartment blocks, cobbled streets, some bare volcanic slopes.

86.name: Pacific Northwest conifer roads
86.note: Tall firs and spruce lining yellow-lined roads, green brushy verges, lawned houses with conifers, clear sky.

87.name: Atacama coastal desert
87.note: Bare sand and gravel desert, flat dusty roads, deep blue skies, block walls and palms in coastal towns.

88.name: South African Karoo and suburbs
88.note: Low gray scrub flats under flat-topped hills, yellow-edge-line and gravel roads; also walled suburban houses with palms and green verges.

89.name: Texas-style brick subdivisions
89.note: New brick houses on wide concrete streets, flat dry pasture with bare trees, yellow-lined roads and wire fences.

90.name: Dry Western US small towns
90.note: Wide low-curb streets with ranch houses and leafy trees, dry gravel edges, sagebrush highways and wooden power poles.

91.name: Green southern Chilean roads
91.note: Two-lanes lined with eucalyptus and pine, green verges, painted wooden houses, wooden poles, sunny or partly cloudy sky.

92.name: Hazy northern Nigerian plains
92.note: Washed-out pale or purple-hazed sky, flat dry savanna with scattered trees, paved roads with sandy red shoulders, block walls.

93.name: Render estates and moor lanes
93.note: Gray render and pebbledash semi-detached houses on wide estate roads, plus heather and gorse moor single-tracks.

94.name: Southern Italian plaster towns
94.note: Pastel plaster houses with balconies and gates, terracotta roofs, parked cars on narrow streets; range adds olive-lined rural lanes.

95.name: Empty grass-verge palm highways
95.note: Lined two-lanes with wide grass verges, scrub and oil palms, few buildings, white or cumulus skies.

96.name: Belgian brick ribbon streets
96.note: Concrete or asphalt roads lined by detached and row brick houses, hedges, gray slate roofs, parked cars.

97.name: Patagonian mountain towns
97.note: Concrete town streets with low colorful houses and mountains behind, plus pale gravel roads over flat scrub steppe.

98.name: Indian sandy town lanes
98.note: Dusty tan dirt or patched lanes, colorful concrete houses and shops, palms, overhead wires, often blurred ground; range adds rural tracks.

99.name: Rwandan banana-hill roads
99.note: Green-smeared road surface, banana groves, eucalyptus, red earth cuts on hilly terrain, brick houses behind walls.

100.name: Bolivian lowland roads
100.note: Green grassy verges and scrub trees, pale dirt and yellow-line paved roads, brick-walled houses, cloudy skies.

101.name: Puerto Rico and USVI house lanes
101.note: Railed-porch concrete houses, lush jungle and hedges, palms, narrow paved lanes, sunny cumulus sky; some red or white car hood.

102.name: Dry Anatolian hill backroads
102.note: Tan dry grassy hills, pale worn roads, block-wall villages, poplar lanes, snowy flat plateaus under deep blue sky.

103.name: Andorra and southern France
103.note: Stone and rendered town streets, French suburban houses behind walls, rocky mountain pass roads with guardrails.

104.name: California and Hawaii suburbs
104.note: Stucco houses with lawns and parked cars, palms and eucalyptus, concrete curbs, wooden poles, some green island hills.

105.name: Flat Omani sand plains
105.note: Pale sand or gravel roads across featureless flat sand to a straight horizon, no poles or buildings, hazy blue sky.

106.name: Hokkaido and Russian Far East
106.note: Wide lined two-lanes through open farmland and birch-deciduous woods, boxy metal-roof houses, sparse settlements.

107.name: Bhutan mountain roads
107.note: Narrow winding single-lane roads cut into steep green forested slopes, rock walls and drainage ditches, mountains behind.

108.name: Argentine Chaco scrub roads
108.note: Flat dense green thorn scrub, pale sandy dirt roads, straight two-lane asphalt with yellow center lines, often overcast sky.

109.name: US-Mexico desert towns
109.note: Bare sandy desert flats with low scrub, cracked asphalt streets, block walls, stucco houses and palms, clear blue sky.

110.name: Dominican walled town streets
110.note: Gated walled residential streets, painted two-story houses with tiled roofs, overhead wires, palms, shops on wider streets.

111.name: Hong Kong and Macau high-rises
111.note: Dense high-rise apartment towers, red double-decker buses, railings and flyovers, wide reclaimed boulevards, wooded hill roads.

112.name: Red-soil outback roads
112.note: Red-orange dirt verges and tracks, sparse low scrub and gums on flat plains, white-lined asphalt, deep blue sky.

113.name: Argentine dry monte roads
113.note: Dusty roads through dry green scrub and poplar rows, yellow center lines, bare dirt lots, clear blue sky.

114.name: Ugandan savanna dirt lanes
114.note: Red-dirt village lanes through grassy savanna with scattered trees, banana plants, tin-roof shacks and market stalls.

115.name: Norwegian valley highways
115.note: Two-lane roads with yellow center lines and guardrails, birch scrub verges, steep green mountains, sunny glare.

116.name: Boat captures and northern lakes
116.note: Camera on a boat over open water with rocky shores, plus overcast yellow-line highways through autumn scrub and aspen.

117.name: Greenland towns and boat runs
117.note: Colorful wooden houses on rocky ground, gravel tracks, snow patches, smeared car rig, and boat-wake shots on gray fjords.

118.name: Singapore and Indonesian streets
118.note: Singapore tower blocks and landscaped avenues, plus narrow Indonesian lanes with gated houses and coconut palms.

119.name: Namibian white-hood roads
119.note: White camera-car hood in view, pale sandy shoulders, flat dry bush with acacias, wide asphalt with yellow edge lines, low walled towns.

120.name: Guam and Marianas roads
120.note: Asphalt roads with grass verges and yellow lines, coconut palms, strip malls, wooden poles, some sun glare.

121.name: Caribbean Colombia sandy towns
121.note: Sandy dirt streets, pastel single-story concrete houses, flat lowlands with dry trees, yellow-line two-lane highways.

122.name: Mexican dense-bush narrow roads
122.note: Narrow gray asphalt or dirt roads hemmed in by thick green bush and low trees, flat terrain, sunny cumulus sky, few buildings.

123.name: Pale-verge bushveld highways
123.note: Dark asphalt with yellow edge lines and wide white-gravel shoulders, flat dry thornbush savanna with acacias, open hazy sky, white gravel roads.

124.name: Flat Kazakh steppe highways
124.note: White camera-car hood in view, straight gray two-lanes across flat tan or green steppe to the horizon, few buildings, wide sky.

125.name: Full-tarp steppe highways
125.note: Large tarp-bundled roof rack filling the lower frame, straight paved roads across flat steppe or past fenced colored-roof villages.

126.name: Cyprus and Aegean pine hills
126.note: Pine and scrub hillsides with rock cuts, white villa-and-flat streets, polytunnel farm lanes, bright hazy sun.

127.name: Botswana white-sand thornveld
127.note: White sandy ground and tracks, flat gray thorn scrub with acacias, worn gray asphalt, pale hazy sky, sparse village yards.

128.name: Dry-season Ghana red-dirt tracks
128.note: Orange laterite dirt roads and shoulders, dry savanna with scattered trees and leafless bush, sparse village houses.

129.name: Amazon forest-edge roads
129.note: Red dirt and yellow-center paved roads, dense tropical forest and pasture edges, wooden houses, cumulus skies.

130.name: Faroese green-slope roads
130.note: Steep treeless green slopes, white-lined two-lanes with guardrails along fjords, black or red houses, low cloud on the hills.

131.name: Atlantic Canada spruce roads
131.note: Scrubby spruce and dry grass verges, siding houses on open lots, yellow center lines, wide pale sky, occasional rocky coast.

132.name: Reunion volcanic-slope roads
132.note: Lined winding roads on steep green slopes, stone retaining walls, guardrailed divided highways, tin-roof houses, dark rock cuttings.

133.name: Empty Patagonian steppe straights
133.note: Straight gravel or yellow-lined paved roads across flat brown shrub steppe, no buildings, wide flat horizon.

134.name: Maltese limestone walls and lanes
134.note: Pale limestone townhouses with balconies, dry-stone rubble walls along dusty tracks, low scrub, overcast or bright sky.

135.name: Curacao railed-wall house lanes
135.note: Railed white walls, low tiled-roof houses, pale concrete lanes, dry cactus scrub and dirt tracks, bright cumulus sky, car hood visible.

136.name: Peruvian coastal desert roads
136.note: Sandy bare verges, scattered flat-topped trees, yellow-lined asphalt, low brick and adobe houses with walls under bright sky.

137.name: Florida oak-and-palm suburbs
137.note: Flat lawned streets with live oaks, Spanish moss and palms, single-story houses, mailboxes, sandy verges, wide arterials.

138.name: NZ tussock and mountain roads
138.note: Open roads through dry tussock flats and bare brown mountains, white edge lines, wooden poles, bright sun or flat white sky.

139.name: High-desert yellow-line highways
139.note: Double-yellow two-lanes through sagebrush and juniper scrub, pale dry ground, low ridges, a few ranch-house desert towns.

140.name: Russian taiga highways
140.note: Smooth wide asphalt with white lines and gravel shoulders, walls of birch and pine forest, flat land, mostly overcast sky.

141.name: Gray-sky far-south Patagonia
141.note: Overcast sky over yellow-lined steppe roads, bare tundra-like grass and colorful tin-roof town streets.
